title: Test RF admission and occupancy compliance
description: Implement independent configured-constraint tests at every Python/Rust/C transmission path. Validate both legal and adaptive ceilings, physical-frequency/channel-group alias accounting, control/forwarding/retry/parity costs, future complete-operation fit and restart/wall-clock safety. For ordinary narrow FHSS enforce aggregate0.4s perfrequency in20s evenwith128channels; two250ms emissions insidewindow cannotbothpass. Distinguish DTSbandwidth andhybridcomponentconditions; channelcount/tuning are notapproval. Cover empty/insufficient eligiblehopset, duplicatefrequencies, sparsemasks, unknownplans, power/antenna configurationconstraints, band-edge inputs and remotepermission expansion. Independently validate interval-boundary overlap/rounding; don't reuse production duty tracker as oracle.
acceptance_criteria: Tests prove actual TX denied on constraint violations, including fallback/SOS/control and aliases; all three implementations agree with independently encoded constraints under declared operating basis. Exactly recorded legal sources/configuration and raw results; software compliance distinguished from RF emissions/equipment authorization. Three independent code reviews with findings filed/fixed; no hardware/Part97 bypass.
